title: Dangerous Experience
description: A challenge pack that makes gaining Experience deal damage
body:
## Overview
This Datapack makes all gained experience damage you. The ammount of damage a single experience does can be configured using ``/trigger evilxp.scaling set [value]``, [value] can not be a decimal number.

## Technical Info
This data pack can only run in 1.20.2 and up since it uses function macros, which were first introduced in 1.20.2.
